changelog.title: 🏪 Businesses are open — buy a shop, let the till fill, come back and collect
changelog.body:
New Business tab in the menu. Buy a shop and it earns credits for you around the clock — from a 5,000 credit Lemonade Stand all the way up to a Nightclub.

HOW IT WORKS
Every business fills a till. Empty it with !collect in chat, or the Collect all button on the Business page. The catch: a till only holds about 8 hours of takings, and once it's full the business STOPS earning until you clear it. The money is only there if you come back for it.

TRADING HOURS
Your shops earn their full rate while the stream is LIVE, and 35% of it once the stream is off. Being around while we're live is where the money is.

GROWING IT
- Upgrade a business up to level 5 — double the rate
- Hire a manager to triple how much its till can hold, handy if you can't check in often
- Buy more slots: you start with room for 2 businesses and can run up to 6

WATCH YOUR TILL
Uncollected takings are cash sitting in a register, and !rob can take them. No safe or vault covers them. Add Security to a business to hide up to 75% of its till from thieves — or just collect it, which hides all of it. An untended till is the easiest money in the channel to steal.

COMMANDS
!business — what you own and what's waiting in the tills
!collect — empty every till you own
!empire [user] — look up anyone's empire

One more thing: emptying the tills sometimes runs into a business event. A clip goes viral, the health inspector calls, someone's been at the register. It swings what you walk away with, for better or worse.

Good luck out there.

changelog.title: Rock Paper Scissors — play the house, or play each other
changelog.body:
New in the casino: rock, paper, scissors. Two ways to play.

vs House — pick your throw and go. A tie gives your stake back, a win pays 1.92× your bet.

Multiplayer — open a table at whatever stake you like and play another viewer best of 3 for the pot. Ties replay, you get 20 seconds a round, and the winner takes both stakes less a small rake. Leave the challenge box blank and anyone can sit down, or name someone to call them out directly — either way it gets announced in chat so people know a table is waiting.

Both stakes are held safely for the whole match: if nobody joins your table, or the match can't be finished, your credits come straight back.

changelog.title: Portfolio value chart matches your credits again
changelog.body: Snapshots were only being recorded for people holding shares, so if you held none the chart sat frozen at an old figure while your balance moved on. Everyone with credits now gets a point every tick, and the chart is topped off with your live value when it loads — so with no stocks it reads exactly the credits shown in the top right.

changelog.title: Freezer fish show hours, not days
changelog.body: Ages in an expanded net stack used to flip over to “2d” at 48 hours, which told you nothing about how much of a freezer’s 72-hour window was left. Ages now stay in hours until the fish is actually past its freshness window, and hovering over one tells you how long it stays fresh.

changelog.title: Blackjack fits on a phone screen again
changelog.body: The table was still sized for the desktop layout, so on a phone you could see the dealer’s cards or the buttons, never both. Tighter table spacing plus hit/stand/double/split moved to the top of the panel, four across, means the dealer, your hand and every button fit without scrolling — split hands included. Desktop is unchanged.

changelog.title: Crime shop: hide your stocks from robbers
changelog.body: The safe only ever covered cash, so stocks had nothing to buy against them. Two new permanent buys fix that: Shell Company (90,000) hides 40% of the stock a robber can reach, and Blind Trust (300,000) hides 75%. Neither makes you untouchable on purpose — and one crowbar still goes through both a safe and a shelter in the same job.

changelog.title: Casino games sorted by what’s hot
changelog.body: The lobby orders game tiles by plays in the last 24 hours, busiest first.

changelog.title: Fishing page tidy-up + top 25 anglers
changelog.body: In Your Net the bulk-sell dropdown and button now sit with the rest of the sell controls, straight under “Sell everything”, and the fish decay explanation moved behind a “More info” collapsible like the one on the rakeback card. The gear shop’s wall of text is collapsible too, the blurb under the stake gear is gone, and Top Anglers now lists 25 instead of 10.

changelog.title: 2x never overshoots your balance
changelog.body: On every slot game the 2x button doubles your bet as before — unless doubling would put it past your credits, in which case it fills in your whole balance instead of a bet you can’t place. No more bouncing off “Can’t bet more than your balance”.

changelog.title: Market page reshuffled on mobile
changelog.body: On phones the stocks tab now reads portfolio value, your portfolio, chart, tickers, trade — with market news pushed down to the bottom, so the two things you check first aren’t split apart by the news feed. “How the market works” is its own collapsible section at the very top, styled like the rakeback card on casino, and it sits first on desktop now too.

changelog.title: Added Dragon Tower to the casino
Removed sonar ping from the fishing shop
Bigger Waters: 100 Species & New Gear
changelog.body: The collection log just got a lot deeper — 31 new species have been added to the fishing pool, bringing the total to 100 catchable species across every rarity tier, from the humble Guppy and Crawdad up to the epic Sperm Whale, legendary Selkie, and mythic Ancient Pearl Oyster. Two new consumables have also arrived in the shop: the 📡 Sonar Ping (8,000) locks your next cast onto species still missing from your collection log — perfect for hunting down those last few entries — and the 🧲 Golden Hook (15,000) gives your next catch the best of five weight rolls for chasing personal bests and channel records. Both stack with bait or a lure, so you can combine them for the ultimate trophy hunt.

changelog.title: The criminal shop just got 8 new items
changelog.body:
Eight new pieces of gear for !rob — and this time the defense gets as much as the offense.

Protect yourself: the Reinforced Vault (🏦) hides three quarters of your balance instead of the Safe's half. The Guard Dog (🐕) permanently drops the odds of anyone robbing you. The Silent Alarm (🔔) lets the job land but makes the thief hand a quarter of it straight back. And the Decoy Wallet (👛) caps the next big haul taken off you at 500 — cheap enough for anyone to own.

Pull off bigger jobs: the Crowbar (🪛) cracks a victim's safe wide open. The Fence (🕵️) raises the most you can take from any single job. The Inside Man (📇) rolls your haul twice and keeps the better one. The Smoke Bomb (💨) walks you out of a bodyguard with no fine and no cooldown.

Consumables are only spent when they actually change something — no crowbar wasted on someone who hasn't got a safe, no decoy wallet burned on a small haul. And buying a lower tier of something you already own (a Scooter when you've got the Chopper) now gets refused instead of quietly taking your credits.

changelog.title: Sell one fish at a time, not the whole stack
changelog.body:
Fish of the same species stack together on the fishing page, but they aren’t interchangeable — each has its own weight and decays from its own catch time, so a fresh trophy can sit on top of a pile of rotting ones worth a fraction of it. Selling used to take the entire stack.

Now a stack with more than one fish expands (▸) into the individual catches — weight, age and current value each, with their own Sell button. !fishsell takes a count and best/worst too: !fishsell bass 1 cashes in your most valuable bass, !fishsell bass 2 worst dumps the two cheapest. A bare !fishsell bass still sells the whole stack, same as before.

Keeping the cheap ones is useful now instead of just unavoidable — !cook eats the cheapest fish of a tier first, so a decayed pile is cook fodder you no longer have to liquidate to cash in the good catch.

changelog.title: You can no longer tip frozen accounts
Sell your fish straight from chat with !fishsell
changelog.body:
No more hopping over to the fishing page to cash in — !fishsell empties your net right from chat.

!fishsell all — sell the whole net
!fishsell common — sell just that rarity (uncommon, rare, epic… all work)
!fishsell rare- — sell that tier and everything below it
!fishsell golden koi — sell a single species

Typing !fishsell on its own just lists the options, so you can't fat-finger away your trophies. Prices, decay and your collection log are unchanged — it's the same sale the fishing page has always done, just faster.
